# toolbar-navigation

<!-- okfreq:index:start -->
<!-- Generated by okfreq lint; edit requirement metadata instead. -->

- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-001 — The toolbar has five rows of titled buttons that float over the page](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-001.md) — When a preview page is built, the extension SHALL render the toolbar, named Preview controls with the role toolbar, as five rows of at most three buttons in a fixed order (for a writable preview: Refresh, Edit and the collapse button; Anchor, Back and Next; Theme, Zoom out and Zoom in; Width and Table of contents; Fold, Diff and Comments), give every button a data-tooltip equal to its title, show that tooltip with a readable contrast on hover and on keyboard focus, and fix the toolbar at the top right of the pane above the page content, inside the pane and without overlap between its rows.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-002 — A soft shadow under the sticky heading band shows only while text scrolls under it](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-002.md) — When the preview is scrolled so that text passes under the sticky heading band, the extension SHALL draw a soft shadow below the band in the colour set of the active theme, and SHALL draw none while the page is at the top, without moving the content or the toolbar.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-003 — A chevron folds the section under a heading](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-003.md) — When the reader presses the chevron of a heading of the content, or the section shortcut with that heading current, the extension SHALL hide every block after the heading up to the next heading of the same or a higher level, keep the heading shown with its chevron marked folded, and show the blocks again when the chevron is pressed again.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-004 — The folded sections are a view state kept per document](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-004.md) — When a section is folded or unfolded, the extension SHALL keep the folded headings of the document in the webview state by level, text and occurrence, apply them again after every content update and reload, and never change the document text.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-005 — Fold all and unfold all fold every section from the toolbar and the command palette](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-005.md) — When the reader presses the Fold button of the toolbar, or runs the command Fold All Sections in Preview or Unfold All Sections in Preview, the extension SHALL fold every section that has content, or unfold every section, in the preview that has the focus.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-006 — Search and navigation unfold the folded section of their target](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-006.md) — When the browser find reaches text inside a folded section, or the page navigates to an anchor, a table-of-contents entry or a link target inside one, the extension SHALL unfold the folded sections that contain the target before it is shown.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-007 — The chevron collapses the toolbar to its first row](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-007.md) — When the reader presses the collapse button, the extension SHALL toggle the hidden attribute of the group that holds the navigation and view rows, which takes them out of the Tab order, set the button label, title and tooltip to Show view controls when collapsed or Hide view controls when expanded with aria-expanded to match, and set the attribute data-sphinx-preview-toolbar-state of the page root to collapsed or expanded.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-008 — Blocks in a folded section cannot be edited](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-008.md) — While a section is folded, the extension SHALL leave the blocks of that section out of the block selection and out of the editable blocks, so that no block inside it can be selected or edited until the section is unfolded.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-009 — Cmd/Ctrl+F opens a find bar over the preview](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-009.md) — When the reader presses Cmd+F (macOS) or Ctrl+F (other systems) with the focus in the preview page, including a field of an open block, table cell or frontmatter editor, the extension SHALL open a find bar over the preview at once with its field focused, so the keys typed next go to the query, close it on Escape, and leave the key to VS Code when the focus is in the text editor.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-010 — The find bar paints the matches of the rendered text and walks them](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-010.md) — While the find bar holds a query, the extension SHALL paint every match in the rendered text of the page, show the match count, move the current match with Enter, Shift+Enter and F3 and unfold the folded sections that hold it.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-011 — The find bar matches case, whole words and regular expressions](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-011.md) — The find bar SHALL offer the options match case, whole word and regular expression, and SHALL report an invalid regular expression in place of the count instead of searching.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-012 — Replace edits only the matched source spans](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-012.md) — When the reader replaces matches from the find bar, the extension SHALL replace the source span of each match that maps one-to-one to the source, and no other text, in one undo step.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-013 — The host accepts only a known view preference with a valid value](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-013.md) — When a previewViewPreferenceChanged message reaches the host, the extension SHALL accept it only for a known preference with a value valid for that preference (zoom: an integer from 70 to 200; widthMode: margin, auto or full; toc, incomingChanges, comments and toolbarCollapsed: a boolean) and drop every other message without an answer.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-014 — Replace is unavailable in a read-only preview](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-014.md) — While the preview is read-only or a block editor is open, the find bar SHALL keep finding and SHALL refuse every replacement with the reason, without editing the document.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-018 — The sticky band shows the current heading path](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-018.md) — When a heading of level h1 to h6 of the running text lies at or above the reading line, the extension SHALL show in the sticky band that heading and its nearest parent headings, one line each, up to the depth setting, each line written with its # markers and without comment chips, and hide the band and empty its text when no heading lies at or above the reading line.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-022 — The sticky heading depth setting decides how many levels stay pinned](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-022.md) — When the page reads markdownOkfSchemaStudio.preview.stickyHeadingDepth, the extension SHALL round it, keep it between 1 and 6, use 3 when it is not a number, show at most that many band lines, and load the full page again with the new depth, rather than patch the content in place, when the setting changes while a preview is open.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-025 — The sticky band is fixed, aligned with the column and clear of the toolbar](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-025.md) — When the band is shown, hidden or changes its number of lines, the extension SHALL keep it fixed to the top of the pane at full width with no gap above it, outside the document flow and ignoring pointer events, with its text aligned to the content column, ending before the toolbar and narrowed by the table of contents reserve, wrapping a long heading path onto more lines, and draw it flat and bold, ended by a one pixel rule.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-030 — The reading offset below the band settles without oscillation](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-030.md) — When the band changes its height or the page updates it after a layout change, the extension SHALL keep the reading offset at least as large as the allowance for the configured depth and the largest band height seen at the current pane width, start the remembered height again when the width changes, measure and update at most three times, and cause at most two corrective scrolls after the end of scrolling input.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-033 — The Table of contents button shows and hides the column](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-033.md) — When the reader presses the Table of contents button, the extension SHALL toggle the open state of the column, set the button's aria-pressed, label, title and tooltip to Hide table of contents when open or Show table of contents when closed, set the attribute data-sphinx-preview-toc of the page root to open or closed, and run the layout update for the changed available width once.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-037 — The column sits below the toolbar on the right and never covers the text](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-037.md) — When the column is open, the extension SHALL place it eight pixels below the toolbar and, on a pane of at least 760 pixels, show it as a fixed 240 pixel column 16 pixels from the right edge with 256 pixels reserved from the content so that the text and the tables stay clear of it, and on a narrower pane hide it while the choice stays.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-040 — The column lists the h1 to h4 headings with folding](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-040.md) — When the column is built, the extension SHALL list the headings h1 to h4 of the content container that have text, in document order, indented by their level below the shallowest listed heading, with the heading text only, a Table of contents landmark and a twisty on each entry that has deeper entries.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-045 — The column marks the section being read and jumps on click](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-045.md) — When the reading line passes a heading, the extension SHALL mark the entry of the last heading at or above the reading line (one pixel tolerance) with aria-current location and a tint with a bar, keep that entry visible by scrolling the column, and scroll the heading of a clicked entry to the reading line below the sticky band without navigating.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-054 — Back and Next follow the host's history state](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-054.md) — When the page starts, the page receives a history state for its render or the reader presses Back or Next, the extension SHALL keep both buttons disabled until the host reports a place to go to, enable each only when its flag in the state is true, and post one history move per press, which the host answers by moving, by posting the state again when there is nowhere to go, or by a warning when the document cannot be opened.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-056 — A history state of another render is ignored](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-056.md) — When previewHistoryState names another document, document version or request than the page's render, the extension SHALL ignore it.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-058 — The host accepts only back or forward](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-058.md) — When a previewHistoryGo message reaches the host, the extension SHALL accept it only when its direction is back or forward and it names the current render.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-059 — Followed links and anchor jumps are recorded per panel and replayed at their line](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-059.md) — When the reader follows a link to another Markdown document in a preview that follows the active editor, or an anchor of the shown document that resolves to a source line, the extension SHALL record the place in the history of that panel, and when Back or Next leads to a recorded place, open its document with the stored line selected or scroll the preview to the stored line.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-065 — The history keeps the last 50 places without duplicates](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-065.md) — When a place is pushed to the history of a panel, the extension SHALL keep at most the 50 newest places, add no duplicate of the current place and drop the places after the current one.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-070 — Back and Next save an open editor first](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-070.md) — When the reader presses Back or Next while a block or properties editor is open, the extension SHALL post the final save of the editor and then the history move.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-071 — A link to another file saves an open editor first](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-071.md) — When the reader follows a link whose request does not start with # while an editor is open, the extension SHALL post the final save and then the link request.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-072 — An anchor of the same page keeps the editor open](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-072.md) — When the reader follows a link whose request starts with #, the extension SHALL post it at once and leave an open editor open.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-077 — A click or Enter on a link is routed to the host and opened or refused with a warning](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-077.md) — When the reader clicks, middle-clicks or presses Enter or Space on a link that carries a navigation request, the extension SHALL cancel the default action, post previewLink with that request and have the host open the target or show a warning with the reason when it cannot.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-079 — Links in view are looked up in bounded batches](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-079.md) — When a link with a navigation request scrolls into view, the extension SHALL ask the host once for the target of its request, in previewLinkDiscover messages of at most 64 requests, and the host answers with previewLinkTargets that lists, for each request in order, its kind and its path or reason.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-083 — The host accepts discovery messages of bounded size](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-083.md) — When a previewLinkDiscover message reaches the host, the extension SHALL accept it only when its requests are an array of at most 64 strings of at most 4096 characters each.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-085 — A link shows its target kind in a tooltip without changing its target](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-085.md) — When the page receives previewLinkTargets, the extension SHALL set on every link with a matching request the attribute data-sphinx-preview-link-state to the kind and the title to the path, else the reason, else the request, follow a link to a blocked target with a warning icon that carries the reason, and keep the original navigation request and the look of the link unchanged.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-090 — A link is an anchor, external, local or blocked](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-090.md) — When a link request is followed or looked up, the extension SHALL classify it before any file access as an anchor, an external link or a relative or wiki path, and block it with a reason when it is an invalid anchor, a query-only target, an undecodable path, a scheme other than http, https or mailto, or an absolute path. The scheme is read on the raw link, and the host re-checks the parsed URI before opening it.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-094 — A local link target must be a regular file inside the workspace](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-094.md) — When a relative Markdown link is followed, the extension SHALL open its target only when the target is a regular file whose path and real path are below a workspace root, and block every other link with the reason of the first check that failed.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-098 — A wikilink is found by file name, or refused when ambiguous or empty](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-098.md) — When a wikilink is followed, the extension SHALL search every workspace root for a note of that file name (with .md added when the name has no extension) and open it when exactly one valid file matches, or the file of that name next to the document when none is found, and block the link when several match or no file does.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-102 — A link fragment selects a source line, block id, label, heading or field](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-102.md) — When a followed link names a fragment or a frontmatter marker, the extension SHALL select the first source line outside fenced code blocks that the fragment names (#L{n} or #L{n}-L{m} lines, #^{id} block id, a MyST (label)= line, an explicit {#id}, an HTML heading id or the slug of an ATX or setext heading) or that holds the marker followed by the exact identity, and select nothing when no line matches.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-113 — A link message needs a request, else it is ignored or refused](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-113.md) — When previewLink reaches the host, the extension SHALL record the page's scroll state and follow the link only when the message carries a request, ignoring a message without one and refusing a malformed frontmatter link request with the reason The frontmatter link request is invalid.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-117 — An in-page anchor scrolls the page to its target at the reading line](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-117.md) — When the reader follows an anchor, the extension SHALL post navigateAnchor with the anchor value and, when the shown document has a matching fragment, its start and end source lines, so that the page scrolls the mapped block of the source line, else the element whose id equals the decoded value or the value without a leading ^, to the reading line below the band, and does not scroll when no block or element is found or the request names another render.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-120 — The Anchor button switches whether the preview follows the editor](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-120.md) — When the reader presses the enabled Anchor button, or the page learns whether a text editor shows its document, the extension SHALL show the anchor mode and the pairing on the button (data-anchor-mode, aria-pressed, label, title and tooltip, disabled while no text editor shows the file) and, when the mode is turned on, post to the preview the first visible line of each visible text editor that shows its document.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-122 — A pairing message for another document is ignored](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-122.md) — When previewPairing names another document, document version or request than the page's, the extension SHALL not change the Anchor button.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-126 — The host accepts only a boolean anchor mode](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-126.md) — When previewAnchorModeChanged reaches the host, the extension SHALL accept it only when anchorToEditor is a boolean.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-128 — The block at the editor cursor is outlined when the setting is on](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-128.md) — When the setting markdownOkfSchemaStudio.preview.markEditorSelection is true (off by default), the extension SHALL outline in the preview the one block that contains the cursor line of the text editor, which the host sends after each render and when the editor scrolls, without moving the preview unless it follows the editor.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-129 — Toolbar, edit bar and table menu tooltips slide in from the left](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-129.md) — When the reader hovers or focuses a button of the floating toolbar, the edit bar or the table menu, the extension SHALL show its tooltip bubble sliding in from 6 px to the left of its place while fading in over 120 ms, with one shared animation, and SHALL show it without motion when the user prefers reduced motion.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-130 — The toolbar rows unroll as one block and a load hint shows them](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-130.md) — When the reader expands or collapses the toolbar, the extension SHALL unroll or roll up rows 2 to 5 as one block over 160 ms (height and fade), and when a panel opens its preview with the toolbar saved as collapsed, the extension SHALL unroll the rows once for 700 ms and roll them up again without changing the saved choice, cancelled by any pointer or key press, and with no motion when the user prefers reduced motion.

<!-- okfreq:index:end -->
